facts.fact: The Nation reports the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act establishes a coordination committee and was amended by the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes (Amendment) Act, 2024, widening investigators' and courts' powers; no event date beyond the published date 2026-06-22 is used.
